kind: read-only source and canonical effect metadata diagnosis
finding: PrivateBok refund emits a standard PartialUintNote completion transport log before AccountingChanged. Application decoder incorrectly demands every log from the contract be an application event.

format.tag: Poseidon domain-separated commitment; no inspectable namespace prefix

recommendedRepair: Keep known application tags first: malformed known events always reject, including a known-tag three-field collision.
Recognize only exact configured Bok address, three actual Fr fields, authenticated artifact balances slot, nonzero u128 amount.
Require co-resident fully valid AccountingChanged with refunded at least the completion amount.
Retain existing successful receipt, exact full-block/effect equality, source class/constructor/storage authentication and final anchor checks before returning any application events.
Reject unknown logs of every other address/shape/slot/range. Do not expose completion tag/recipient grouping in public application projection.
rationale: The inspected pinned class has one PartialUintNote.complete call, only in Accounting.refund, and one public application event emitter. Canonical successful execution of this authenticated class establishes the emission provenance; the proposed narrow shape exclusion is not general unknown-event tolerance and does not claim cryptographic validation of the tag preimage.
limitations: Actual metadata query itself is diagnostic and does not replace decoder canonical full-effect verification.
